processInfo.processDesc: This process is designed based on ITIL best practices, covering the full lifecycle of change requests (CR) from initiation, assessment, approval, implementation to verification and closure. Through standardized phase control and role collaboration mechanisms, it ensures change risks are manageable, processes are traceable, and results are verifiable, effectively safeguarding the stability and continuity of IT services.
